arxiv-2107-11777.description: Abstract Inertial measurement units are widely used in different fields to estimate the attitude. Many algorithms have been proposed to improve estimation performance. However, most of them still suffer from 1) inaccurate initial estimation, 2) inaccurate initial filter gain, and 3) non-Gaussian process and/or measurement noise.

Much research has been devoted to the design of smart loss functions or data mining strategies for training such networks.

arxiv-2209-08907.title: Learning Symbolic Model-Agnostic Loss Functions via Meta-Learning
arxiv-2209-08907.creator: Christian Raymond, Qi Chen, Bing Xue, and Mengjie Zhang
arxiv-2209-08907.description: Abstract In this paper, we develop upon the emerging topic of loss function learning, which aims to learn loss functions that significantly improve the performance of the models trained under them. Specifically, we propose a new meta-learning framework for learning model-agnostic loss functions via a hybrid neuro-symbolic search approach.

arxiv-2311-10333.title: Topological Discrimination of Steep to Supersteep Gap as Evidence of Tunneling in Adiabatic Quantum Processes
arxiv-2311-10333.creator: E. A. Jonckheere
arxiv-2311-10333.description: Abstract It is shown that the gap that limits the speed of a quantum annealing process can take three salient, stable morphologies: the super-steep , steep , and mild gaps. The difference is the number of pairs of inflection points (2, 1, 0, resp.) near the gap.

arxiv-2312-02508.title: The Diagonals of a Ferrers Diagram
arxiv-2312-02508.creator: Giuseppe Cotardo, Anina Gruica, Alberto Ravagnani
arxiv-2312-02508.description: Abstract We propose and develop a theory of Ferrers diagrams and their q q -rook polynomials solely based on their diagonals. We show that the cardinalities of the diagonals of a Ferrers diagram are equivalent information to their rook numbers, q q -rook polynomials, and the rank distribution of matrices supported on the diagram.

arxiv-2410-05122.title: Generalised Quantum Gates for Qudits and their Application in Quantum Fourier Transform
arxiv-2410-05122.creator: Francesco Pudda, Mario Chizzini, Luca Crippa
arxiv-2410-05122.description: Abstract Quantum computing with qudits, quantum systems with d > 2 d>2 levels, offers a powerful extension beyond qubits, expanding the computational possibilities of quantum systems, allowing the simplification of the implementation of several algorithms and, possibly, providing a foundation for optimised error correction.

arxiv-2511-01467.title: Quantum Information Ordering and Differential Privacy
arxiv-2511-01467.creator: Ayanava Dasgupta, Naqueeb Ahmad Warsi, Masahito Hayashi
arxiv-2511-01467.description: Abstract We study quantum differential privacy (QDP) by defining a notion of the order of informativeness between two pairs of quantum states. In particular, we show that if the hypothesis testing divergence of the one pair dominates over that of the other pair, then this dominance holds for every f f -divergence.

pmc-10614309.title: The favorable outcome of Bernese periacetabular osteotomy for the hip osteoarthritis in multiple epiphyseal dysplasia
pmc-10614309.creator: Yao-Yuan Chang, Chia-Che Lee, Sheng-Chieh Lin, Ken N Kuo, Jia-Feng Chang, Kuan-Wen Wu, Ting-Ming Wang
pmc-10614309.description: BackgroundMultiple epiphyseal dysplasia (MED) is a rare congenital bone dysplasia. Patients with MED develop secondary hip osteoarthritis as early as the third to the fourth decade. Currently, there is no consensus on the prevention of the progressive hip osteoarthritis secondary to MED. The Bernese periacetabular osteotomy (PAO) is a joint-preserving surgery to reshape acetabulum and extend femoral head coverage.

pmc-11463955.creator: Yanira Jiménez-Padilla, Babafemi Adewusi, Marc-André Lachance, Brent J. Sinclair
pmc-11463955.description: Insect guts house a complex community of microbes that affect host physiology, performance and behavior. Gut microbiome research has largely focused on bacteria–host symbioses and paid less attention to other taxa, such as yeasts. We found that axenic Drosophila melanogaster (reared free of microbes) develops from egg to adult more slowly (ca.

pmc-11550213.title: Understanding the complex macrophage landscape in MASLD
pmc-11550213.creator: Federico F De Ponti, Zhuangzhuang Liu, Charlotte L Scott
pmc-11550213.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). SummaryMetabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) represents a spectrum of disease states ranging from simple steatosis to metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), which can eventually lead to the development of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. Macrophages have long been implicated in driving the progression from steatosis to end-stage disease, yet we still know relatively little about the precise involvement of these cells in MASLD progression and/or regression. Rather, there are a considerable number of conflicting reports regarding the precise roles of these cells.

pmc-11557818.title: Development and Validation of a Patient-Reported Outcome Measure of the Impact of Chronic Hand Eczema on Health-Related Quality of Life: the Hand Eczema Impact Scale (HEIS)
pmc-11557818.creator: Elke Weisshaar, Yasemin Topal Yüksel, Tove Agner, Lotte Seiding Larsen, Laura Grant, Rob Arbuckle, Amy M Jones, Piper Fromy, Cherry Lou Balita-Crisostomo, Nanna Nyholm Mathiasen, Henrik Thoning, Christian Apfelbacher
pmc-11557818.description: IntroductionChronic Hand Eczema (CHE) is an inflammatory skin disease that causes significant impact on health-related quality of life (HRQoL). The Hand Eczema Impact Scale (HEIS) is a new patient-reported outcome (PRO) measure designed to assess the impact of CHE on key domains of HRQoL. This study aimed to develop and evaluate content and psychometric validity of the HEIS.

pmc-12455405.title: Composite chronic lymphocytic leukemia and mantle cell lymphoma involving the bone marrow: a case report and literature review
pmc-12455405.creator: Roksolana Demianets, Susan O’Brien, Khosrow Mahdavi, Chenchen Niu, Sumayya Aslam, Truc Tran, Ying Zhang, Ashley Gamayo, Xiaohui Zhao, Sherif A Rezk
pmc-12455405.description: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma (CLL/SLL) is a clinically indolent lymphoproliferative disorder characterized by accumulation of mature B-cell lymphocytes. Given the common CD5 co-expression, mantle cell lymphoma (MCL) is one of the most important entities in the differential diagnosis. MCL and CLL/SLL might exhibit overlapping morphologic and immunohistochemical features, making diagnosis particularly difficult in cases of composite lymphomas.

pmc-13145936.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1531 PROINFLAMMATORY CYTOKINES AND MATRIX METALLOPROTEINASE-9 ACTIVITY AS BIOMARKERS OF COGNITIVE IMPAIRMENT IN HEMORRHAGIC STROKE
pmc-13145936.creator: Gulnora Rakhimbaeva, Yulduz Musaeva, Sardor Musayev, Sevara Kalandarova, Tolibjon Khomidov
pmc-13145936.description: Background and aimsNeuroinflammation is a key mechanism of secondary brain injury in intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) and may contribute to post-stroke cognitive impairment. Proinflammatory cytokines interleukin-1β (IL-1β), interleukin-6 (IL-6), and matrix metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9) are involved in blood–brain barrier disruption and neuronal damage; however, their relationship with cognitive dysfunction in ICH remains insufficiently defined.

pmc-13441481.title: N-myristoyltransferase 1, a key gene for protein N-myristoylation, is dispensable for fertility in male mice
pmc-13441481.creator: Yang LIU, Yvxia ZHANG, Hailing DING, Jie LI, Tingting GAO, Zongzhuang WEN, Yunshan WANG, Bin WU
pmc-13441481.description: N-Myristoyltransferase 1 (NMT1), the predominant enzyme catalyzing myristoylation of proteins, is involved in various biological processes, including early embryonic development, immune responses, apoptosis, cellular homeostasis, tumorigenesis, and infection, with therapeutic potential in viral and parasitic infections as well as cancer.

pmc-13556842.title: 200. Psychotropic use, initiation, and healthcare trajectories in the 180 days before suicide
pmc-13556842.creator: Y-S Li, S-J Tsai, C-M Cheng, Y-M Bai, T-J Chen, M-H Chen
pmc-13556842.description: BackgroundSuicide is a major public health challenge globally and the tenth leading cause of death in Taiwan. Although psychiatric disorders, emergency visits, and psychotropic prescribing are known correlates of suicide, evidence from Asian populations remains limited—particularly regarding the timing, continuity, and clinical context of psychiatric versus non-psychiatric care preceding death.

pmc-13568977.title: Multifunctional Thiolated Hyaluronic Acid‐graft‐PEDOT Dressing With Antifouling, On‐Demand Drug Delivery and Electrical Stimulation for Wound Healing
pmc-13568977.creator: Jingwen Yang, Jiwon Hong, Anthony Phillips, Bicheng Zhu, Jenny Malmstrom, Devon T. Bryant, Alireza Akbarinejad, Lisa I. Pilkington, Jadranka Travas‐Sejdic
pmc-13568977.description: Recent advances in electro‐responsive wound dressings have enabled on‐demand drug delivery or electrical stimulation (ES) to accelerate healing; however, integrating both functions within a single platform remains challenging. Here, we report a multifunctional dressing based on a conductive, porous substrate comprising a thiolated hyaluronic acid (THA)‐grafted PEDOT copolymer, P(EDOT‐co‐EDOT‐g‐THA).

pmc-13610845.title: Development, Validation and Application of an RP-HPLC Method for the Determination of Reproxalap in Cyclodextrin Inclusion Complexes and an In Situ Ocular Hydrogel
pmc-13610845.creator: Rumeysa Ceylan, Eren Aytekin, Heybet Kerem Polat, Ozan Kaplan, Mustafa Çelebier, Sibel Bozdağ Pehlivan
pmc-13610845.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: The aim of this study was to develop and validate a simple, accurate, reproducible, and sensitive reverse-phase high-performance liquid chromatography method for the quantification of reproxalap (RP) in cyclodextrin (CD) inclusion complexes and poloxamer 407 hydrogel formulations. Methods: Chromatographic separation was achieved using a mobile phase of deionized water and an organic phase (methanol:acetonitrile, 55:45 v/v) in a 40:60 (v/v) ratio, at a flow rate of 0.9 mL/min and a run time of 10 min.
